name: Indices Tester
summary: This EA is a trend-following trading system designed for index/indices instruments. It generates trade signals based on technical indicator combinations and manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The EA is intended for backtesting and optimization on index CFDs.
summary_zh: 这是一个专为指数品种设计的趋势跟踪交易系统EA。它基于技术指标组合生成交易信号，并通过可配置的止损止盈管理持仓。该EA主要用于指数CFD的回测和优化。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用趋势跟踪策略，通过技术指标的组合判断市场方向并顺势入场。入场条件依赖于指标信号确认，当多头信号满足时开多单，空头信号满足时开空单。出场条件包括止损和止盈的设定，同时也可能包含指标反转信号的平仓逻辑。仓位管理通过固定手数或基于资金比例的方式确定每笔交易的下单量。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损设置来控制单笔风险，但缺少动态仓位调整和最大回撤保护机制。整体策略逻辑相对传统，适合在趋势明显的指数市场中运行，但在震荡市中可能面临频繁止损的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a trend-following strategy that uses combinations of technical indicators to determine market direction and enter trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. Entry conditions rely on indicator signal confirmation, opening long positions when bullish signals align and short positions when bearish signals align. Exit conditions include configurable stop loss and take profit levels, and may also incorporate indicator reversal signals for position closure. Position sizing is handled through fixed lot sizes or account equity-based calculations per trade. Money management provides stop loss settings to control per-trade risk, but lacks dynamic position adjustment and maximum drawdown protection mechanisms. The overall strategy logic is relatively conventional and performs well in trending index markets, but may suffer from frequent stop-outs during ranging or choppy conditions.
pros: 策略逻辑清晰，适合趋势明显的指数市场
参数可配置性强，便于回测优化和参数调优
包含止损止盈机制，具备基本的风险控制
支持多指数品种交易，适用范围较广
代码结构相对简洁，便于理解和修改
pros_en: Clear strategy logic suitable for trending index markets
Highly configurable parameters enabling thorough backtesting and optimization
Includes stop loss and take profit mechanisms providing basic risk control
Supports multiple index instruments with broad applicability
Relatively clean code structure easy to understand and modify
cons: 缺乏震荡市过滤机制，在横盘行情中容易频繁止损
没有动态仓位管理，固定手数无法适应不同波动率环境
缺少最大回撤保护和整体资金管理策略
未包含点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能不利
策略创新性不足，依赖传统指标组合信号
cons_en: Lacks ranging market filter, prone to frequent stop-outs in sideways conditions
No dynamic position sizing to adapt to varying volatility environments
Missing maximum drawdown protection and overall portfolio money management
No spread filter included, potentially disadvantaged under high-spread conditions
Limited strategy innovation, relying on traditional indicator combination signals
improvements: 增加震荡市识别过滤器（如ADX或波动率指标），减少横盘时的无效交易
实现基于ATR的动态止损止盈和仓位管理，适应不同市场波动率
增加最大回撤保护和日内最大亏损限制，提升整体资金安全性
improvements_en: Add a ranging market identification filter (e.g., ADX or volatility indicator) to reduce ineffective trades during sideways markets
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit and position sizing to adapt to varying market volatility
Add maximum drawdown protection and daily loss limits to enhance overall capital safety

risk_points: 缺少最大回撤保护机制，极端行情下可能遭受重大损失
固定手数不根据账户资金动态调整，存在过度杠杆风险
未包含点差和滑点过滤，市场流动性差时成交可能偏离预期
risk_points_en: No maximum drawdown protection mechanism, potentially suffering significant losses during extreme market conditions
Fixed lot sizing without dynamic adjustment based on account equity poses over-leveraging risk
No spread or slippage filter, execution may deviate from expectations during low liquidity periods

summary_en: This EA is a trend-following trading system designed for index/indices instruments. It generates trade signals based on technical indicator combinations and manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The EA is intended for backtesting and optimization on index CFDs.
